NewRaceForm.drawHelp: Tap the map to drop the start, then each waypoint. The path automatically follows tracks and trails.
NewRaceForm.durationHint: How long you think you'll take. Your friends and family will place their messages across this duration.
NewRaceForm.dateHint: Optional. Used to show the date to your friends and family and to archive the race.

LiveClient.prepareIntro: We're downloading the route and {count, plural, =1 {# message} other {# messages}} to this phone. After that, everything works offline: airplane mode, tunnels, the bottom of a valley.
LiveClient.prepareWhen: Do it the day before, on wifi. Count a few seconds per message.
LiveClient.downloadFailed: {count, plural, =1 {# message couldn't be downloaded} other {# messages couldn't be downloaded}}. Restart the preparation with a better connection.
LiveClient.prepareFailed: Preparation failed. Check your connection and try again.
LiveClient.readyStats: {distance} · {count, plural, =1 {# message pending} other {# messages pending}}
LiveClient.tipHeadphones: Put your headphones on. Open-ear or bone-conduction, so you can still hear your surroundings.
LiveClient.tipForeground: Keep this page in the foreground, screen on. A web app can't access GPS in the background.
LiveClient.tipBattery: Turn the brightness down to the minimum: expect around 12% battery per hour.
LiveClient.justFinish: All that's left is to finish.
LiveClient.errorPlayback: A message couldn't be played. The race continues.
LiveClient.errorAudioBlocked: Sound is blocked by the browser. Tap « Start » again and check that your phone isn't on silent.
LiveClient.errorMissingVoice: A voice message is missing from the cache. Re-run the preparation after the race.

TimeLiveClient.prepareIntro: We're downloading {count, plural, =1 {# message} other {# messages}} to this phone. After that, everything works offline, even in airplane mode.
TimeLiveClient.prepareWhen: Do it the day before, on wifi.
TimeLiveClient.downloadFailed: {count, plural, =1 {# message couldn't be downloaded} other {# messages couldn't be downloaded}}. Restart the preparation with a better connection.
TimeLiveClient.prepareFailed: Preparation failed. Check your connection and try again.
TimeLiveClient.readyStats: Target {clock} · {count, plural, =1 {# message pending} other {# messages pending}}
TimeLiveClient.tipHeadphones: Put your headphones on and start the timer the moment you cross the start line.
TimeLiveClient.tipForeground: Keep this page in the foreground, screen on: it's required for the sound to trigger.
TimeLiveClient.tipMessages: Messages play at their scheduled minute on your timer, with no network.
TimeLiveClient.justFinish: All that's left is to finish.
TimeLiveClient.errorPlayback: A message couldn't be played. The race continues.
TimeLiveClient.errorAudioBlocked: Sound is blocked by the browser. Tap « Start » again and check that your phone isn't on silent.
TimeLiveClient.errorMissingVoice: A voice message is missing from the cache. Re-run the preparation after the race.

ContributorFlow.introTime: Pick the moment in the race when your voice will play, then record your message. {name} will hear it right at that point on their timer.
ContributorFlow.introDistance: Pick the point on the course where your voice will play, then record your message. {name} will hear it while running, right at that spot.
ContributorFlow.freeNote: It's free and no account needed. {count, plural, =1 {# message max per person.} other {# messages max per person.}}
ContributorFlow.closedBody: You can no longer leave a message. {name} received all the ones recorded in time.
ContributorFlow.step1Body: {name} will hear “Message from {draft}” just before your voice message. First name or nickname, however they know you.
ContributorFlow.connectionFailed: Couldn't connect. Try again in a moment.
ContributorFlow.badgeRemaining: {count, plural, =1 {# message for you} other {# messages for you}}
ContributorFlow.badgeAllSent: Your {count, plural, =1 {# message sent} other {# messages sent}}
ContributorFlow.fullBadge: {count, plural, =1 {# message sent} other {# messages sent}}
ContributorFlow.fullTitle: Thank you, you gave it your all 💚
ContributorFlow.fullBody: You've left your {count, plural, =1 {# message} other {# messages}} for {name}. That's the per-person limit, to leave room for other friends and family. They'll hear them all during the race.
ContributorFlow.fullRaceTitle: The race is full… for now
ContributorFlow.fullRaceBody: {name} has already received lots of messages! We've just let them know so they can unlock more room. Come back in a little while: your voice will then be able to slip onto the course.
ContributorFlow.step2TimeBody: Slide the cursor across the race's expected duration. Your voice will play when {name}'s timer reaches that moment.
ContributorFlow.step2DistanceBody: Tap the route wherever you like. No need to be precise, we snap it to the course automatically.
ContributorFlow.clickCloser: Tap closer to the race route.
ContributorFlow.step3Body: Thirty seconds max. Get to the point: mid-race, long sentences are hard to follow.
ContributorFlow.sendInterrupted: Sending interrupted. Check your connection and try again.

PublicRacePage.metaDescription: Leave a voice message on {name}'s route. They'll hear it during the race, at the kilometre you choose.
PublicRacePage.footer: By sending a message, you agree to our <terms>terms of use</terms> and our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>. Your voice message can only be heard by {name}.

Admin.configBody: AdSense identifiers are injected when pages render, server-side. An ad only shows if the network is enabled and the client / slot pair is valid • a badly filled field emits no call rather than an invalid one.

AdSettings.adsToggleDesc: Global kill switch. When off, no Google script is loaded on the site.
AdSettings.clientIdHint: Format ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, found in Account › Account information.
AdSettings.clientIdError: Expected format: ca-pub- followed by 10 to 20 digits.
AdSettings.gtmHint: Container ID, format GTM-XXXXXXX. Injected across the whole site to drive your Google tags.
AdSettings.gtmError: Expected format: GTM- followed by letters and digits.
AdSettings.freeCapHint: Beyond that, the runner is emailed to unlock more.
AdSettings.unlockedCapHint: The maximum number of messages once the runner has unlocked the race.
AdSettings.perContributorHint: Anti-spam: how many messages a single person can leave.
AdSettings.unlockPriceHint: Read from the database when the Stripe session is created, never sent by the client.

Recorder.errUnsupported: This browser can’t record a voice message. Open this link in Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android) rather than your messaging app’s built-in browser.
Recorder.errNoDevice: No microphone detected on this device.
Recorder.errBusy: The microphone is being used by another app. Close it and try again.
Recorder.allowHintSafariIos: Tap “Allow microphone” and accept the prompt. If nothing appears, on iPhone tap “aA” at the left of the address bar → Website Settings → Microphone → Allow.
Recorder.allowHintIosOther: On iPhone, recording only works in Safari. Tap the Share icon then “Open in Safari” — or copy the link and paste it into Safari.
Recorder.allowHintChromium: Tap “Allow microphone” and accept the prompt. If nothing appears, click the microphone (or lock) icon at the left of the address bar → allow the microphone, then try again.
Recorder.allowHintGeneric: Tap “Allow microphone” and accept the prompt. If nothing appears, allow the microphone from the icon in the address bar, then try again.
Recorder.iosSafariNotice: On iPhone, recording a voice message only works in Safari. Open this link in Safari: tap the Share icon, then “Open in Safari”.
